THE VAULT: HD VIDEO GAME ART

Welcome to The Vault, a members-only area designed for our Patreon supporters with a penchant for collecting the best! Here, we archive high-resolution art from classics and current games. Our HD Promo Art collection focuses on art that is suitable for wallpapers or wall prints, while our HD Sets page covers logos and characters.

Join our Vault tier to unlock 273 GB of content and member perks, including:

  • 28,323 high-quality HD artworks.
    (No upscaling, AI, scans, or fan art)
  • 1,249 ZIP files of our public art galleries.
    (Non-HD, archived for convenient access)
  • Ad-free experience on Vault pages.
  • Community page for comments & requests.

TOUR THE VAULT

The assets on this page are identical to what logged-in members see. We welcome you to explore the full collection! Simply scroll down and click any game title to display all available assets. Also see our HD Sets page for logos and characters.

GAMING ART PRESERVED

If you love discovering rare or forgotten game artworks, you'll find plenty to explore in The Vault. It's packed with 30+ years of high-res art meticulously preserved from press hubs, media discs, and trade shows. Our HD Promo Art collection aims for 4k res or higher for modern games, while classics predating the 4k era are presented at their highest resolution. Whenever possible, pristine PNGs are exported from original PSD files to ensure lossless quality.

For PSD source files, we prioritize lossless quality by exporting them as PNGs. In rare cases (under 1%), artists may include images with compression artifacts in the PSD. To maintain fidelity to the original artwork, these artifacts are preserved in the PNG export.
